BillHeading.BriefDescription: Prohibiting conversion of agricultural lands to wetlands or fish habitat under the shoreline management act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting conversion of agricultural lands to wetlands or fish habitat under the shoreline management act; and adding a new section to chapter 90.58 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 90.58 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Agricultural land, as defined in RCW 90.58.065, may not be converted to wetland or fish habitat, nor may it be subjected to tidal inundation.
